threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You can spot newcomers by their shocked faces when a bus driver doesn't stop for them, even at a proper bus stop.
Caught a night bus home, and the driver had a plant behind the seat. Turns out it’s been there for months, thriving despite the chaos.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I saw a guy using his bike to haul a full-size sofa down Karl-Marx-Strasse, I knew this place had a character all its own.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Here, it’s common to see a guy playing classical music on the subway while a girl sketches him. Only in Berlin do artists ride the public transport like it’s a stage.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can tell who's local by how they navigate the BART delays. Newcomers just stand there bewildered, but the locals know to grab tacos and wait it out.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Watched a guy bring his pet iguana onto the 14 Mission. Only in San Francisco, right? The bus driver didn’t even blink.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think all the terraces are for paella. Locals know most prefer a menú del dia at the hidden places only the neighborhood kids go.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell they still look for laundromats instead of embracing the 'lavadora' as a neighbor's prized possession in Gràcia.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You keep waiting for the bus on Mare Street, but you’ve never figured out that it stops at the traffic lights, not the shelter.
Last Friday, I saw a guy on the 45 singing opera – had the whole bus in stitches. Gotta love the late-night vibes in Brixton.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I watched my neighbor argue with a pigeon over the last piece of bread in front of the bakery. Only in Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin do you find a techno party happening in a former public toilet. Talk about creative reuse!

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know a true local when they can name the taco truck that’s parked at 16th and Valencia but can’t tell you the BART schedule.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy in a full tuxedo all dressed up, but he was on the Muni with a pizza box. Only in San Francisco, right?

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think all locals are night owls, but I swear, it's the early morning bakeries that reveal the real Gràcia vibe—quiet yet buzzing with life.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by their struggle to decipher the 'hora punta' signs at the metro stations—total deer in headlights.
